app.title: PickArr
app.tagline: Browse streaming catalogs and send titles to Sonarr/Radarr.

admin.heading: Administration
admin.subtitle: See what is queued, what is running, and why a job failed.
admin.runsEmptyJob: No runs for this job yet.

catalog.crossCatalog: My list includes every provider and country.
catalog.noSources: No country catalogs are enabled yet. Add a Watchmode API key in Settings to import Netflix for Italy and the United States.
catalog.emptyArr: Configure Sonarr and/or Radarr in Settings to browse the catalog. Series require Sonarr; movies require Radarr.
catalog.emptyNotImported: The catalog has not been imported yet. Saving a Watchmode API key queues the first import. Open Admin to watch it or run it again.
catalog.emptyImporting: The first catalog import is running. Titles show up here when it finishes.
catalog.emptyLeaving: No leaving dates in the current preview window. On the free Watchmode plan only the next ~10 titles per country are available.
catalog.leavingFreeNote: Free Watchmode plan: leaving dates are a limited preview (about 10 titles per country), not a full calendar.

arr.notConfigured: Arr instance not configured — open Settings.
arr.unreachable: Arr instance is configured but not reachable.
arr.seasonsHint: Sonarr monitors and searches only the seasons you select.
arr.deleteFilesWarning: This permanently deletes media files from disk. It cannot be undone.
arr.missingTvdbId: Missing TVDB, TMDB, and IMDb ids — cannot add to Sonarr.
arr.missingTmdbId: Missing TMDB id — cannot add to Radarr.

favorite.hint: A short watch-later list: titles you might want to see, then remove once watched.

ratings.empty: No ratings in this tab yet.
ratings.disabled: Ratings are turned off in Settings.
ratings.crossCatalog: Ratings are global across every provider and country.

reco.disabled: Recommendations are turned off in Settings.
reco.empty: No recommendations yet. Rate a few titles or wait for the catalog prior.
reco.enabledScopeIntro: Across every enabled catalog. Picks for one provider stay on that catalog page.
reco.includeInLibrary: Include titles already in the library
reco.tasteIntro: Rate a few titles already in your enabled catalogs. Skipped titles are left blank.

title.seasonsEmpty: No season list yet. Run Metadata enrichment, then open the title again.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the current key; clear the field and save empty to remove.
settings.tokenHint: TMDB v3 API key or read access token. Posters, overview, cast, and genres are loaded with it.
settings.testOk: Connected — version {{version}}. Quality profiles and root folders are ready to choose.
settings.optionsHint: These lists fill in when Test connection succeeds.
settings.optionsReady: Loaded from the last successful connection test. Test again after changing the URL or API key.
settings.catalogIntro: Turn a provider on and choose the countries whose catalogs PickArr should keep. Each selected country needs its own Watchmode catalog.
settings.pagesMeasured: {{pages}} pages measured on the last full import
settings.pagesEstimated: about {{pages}} pages until a full import measures the catalog
settings.estimateMonthly: Keeping them updated: {{credits}} credits each month
settings.estimateUsed: {{used}} already used this month, {{total}} of {{quota}} with the monthly updates
settings.estimateNote: The free plan allows 3 countries. Every provider in those countries is included, so the United States on four providers is still one country. Watchmode charges one credit per catalog page, so those four catalogs are billed separately. The monthly figure is the daily incremental sync, four weekly full syncs, and the daily leaving check. The page count is measured after the first full import; until then it uses 32 pages, about 8,000 titles.
settings.estimateOverCountries: The free plan allows {{limit}} countries. Several providers in the same country still count as one.
settings.estimateOverQuota: This selection goes past the {{quota}} credits included in the free plan.
settings.estimateNeedCountry: An enabled provider needs at least one country.
settings.catalogSaved: Catalog selection saved. New countries start importing on the next pass.
settings.catalogLoadFailed: Could not load the catalog selection.
settings.catalogSaveFailed: Could not save the catalog selection.
settings.recoEnabledHint: When off, rating controls and For you stay hidden.
settings.recoUseImplicit: Use My list and library as temporary taste signals
settings.recoUseImplicitHint: My list means “might watch later”: it counts until you rate the title or remove it. Arr adds and downloads also help when there is no rating yet.
settings.recoEmbeddingsEnabledHint: When off, For you stays on sparse/profile scoring even if a model file is present.
settings.recoExploreEnabledHint: Reserves a share of For you slots for titles outside your usual genres.
settings.recoEventsEnabledHint: Stores shown/opened/liked interactions on this machine. Off by default.
settings.recoExcludeInLibraryHint: For you excludes downloaded or monitored titles unless you include them on the page.
settings.recoLocalNote: Recommendations are calculated on this machine. No taste data leaves your install.
settings.recoResetDerivedConfirm: Delete recommendations and embeddings? Ratings stay.
settings.recoResetAllConfirm: Delete recommendations, embeddings, and all ratings?
